content.short: In Gods Unchained, a free-to-play card game on Immutable, the cards you earn are yours to keep and trade.
content.description: Gods Unchained plays like other digital card games. You build a deck, pick a god and battle opponents in turn-based PvP duels. The difference is ownership. Cards earned through play can become NFTs on Immutable, which you can trade or sell on open marketplaces instead of having them locked inside the game. Immutable makes the game, and it has won industry awards in web3 gaming. The game has released many expansions, from Trial of the Gods to Light's Verdict, and players can buy packs, craft cards and trade on its marketplace. The GODS token is used across the game's economy.
